dct_title_s: Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) Major Roads Network (OpenStreetMap Export)
dct_description_sm: République démocratique du Congo (RDC), Réseau routier principal Lines + Polygons : Main roads Network Interactive Online Map [OSM Roads](https://wiki.openstreetmap.org/wiki/Key:highway) Columns: osm_id, highway, name, layer, bridge, tunnel, oneway, ref , route, junction, lanes, width, maxspeed, surface, practicability, smoothness, condition, geometry OSM Filter WHERE highway in ('motorway','motorway_link','trunk','trunk_link','primary','primary_link','secondary','secondary_link','tertiary','tertiary_link', 'unclassified') OR route='ferry' OR amenity in ('ferry_terminal') OR ( (bridge is not null OR tunnel is not null ) AND highway in ('motorway','motorway_link','trunk','trunk_link','primary', 'primary_link','secondary','secondary_link','tertiary','tertiary_link', 'unclassified') ) The second part of the Road network is available from the [Local Roads dataset](https://data.humdata.org/dataset/democratic-republic-of-congo-drc-local-roads-openstreetmap-export)
